measure: Our own doctrine, not generic best practice. Generic advice is free and worthless.

ideas.observation: The knowledge base is only used for one fact a day.
ideas.suggestion: The same sourced facts could power a "why is this card like this" explainer on every product page — set context, print quirks, what makes it odd. It compounds with every fact added.

ideas.observation: artist-instruments.json is written every run and read by nothing — not another script, not the feed.
ideas.suggestion: Either surface it (the app, the Pulse, a creator tool) or stop generating it. Work that runs daily and reaches nobody is the most expensive kind.

ideas.observation: card-guard.json is written every run and read by nothing — not another script, not the feed.
ideas.suggestion: Either surface it (the app, the Pulse, a creator tool) or stop generating it. Work that runs daily and reaches nobody is the most expensive kind.

ideas.observation: date-to-day-key is implemented inline 38 times across the pipeline.
ideas.suggestion: Centralise it — scripts/rotate.mjs already centralises day maths. Repeated maths is where two places drift and only one gets fixed.

ideas.observation: money rounding is implemented inline 12 times across the pipeline.
ideas.suggestion: Centralise it — one helper would make cents behave identically everywhere. Repeated maths is where two places drift and only one gets fixed.

ideas.observation: The daily run imports 62 steps from one file.
ideas.suggestion: Consider grouping them (intake → compute → publish → agents) so the order is legible at a glance. A long flat list is where an ordering mistake hides.
Large files are where two people edit the same function on the same day. Splitting by concern would make collisions rarer and reviews honest.
